_comment: Single source of release notes. Newest first. The app shows these in 'What's new'; fastlane turns the entry matching pubspec.yaml's version into the Play 'What's new' text (max 500 characters). Every release needs an entry.

new: Follow each word as it is recited
The reader scrolls with the recitation
Reading view: Arabic only, with translation, or full
Lessons unlock in order, with a clear learning journey
Streak celebration for your first lesson of the day
What's new: see the changes in each update
fixed: Back button returns to the previous screen
Privacy and Terms open inside the app
Progress updates right after a lesson
You stay signed in: reopening the app takes you to Home
Weak or no connection no longer signs you out
The Read tab shows clearly when it is selected
Daily reminders now work on phones

new: Learn Surah Al-Fatihah and the opening of Al-Baqarah, ayah by ayah
Arabic with translation and word-by-word meaning
Listen to each ayah or the whole lesson
Short exercises and gentle word reviews
